Event:315530455.title: Ginza Holiday Festival (Old Town)
Event:315530455.description:
**READ THE CHAT,**_ we're *first* gonna meet-up ***@ HUDSON CHESS PARK (directly outside of the entrance)*** for \~15 min & then go to the event at **5:45pm\~6:00pm**.

This is a casual hangout event for those attending the Ginza Holiday Festival. This outdoor street fest offers live performances, shopping and food.

**Schedule:**
Don't need to get there 5:30 sharply! It's a more relaxed festival where people are mainly there for the performances, and socialize. The main stage is mainly performance, and then there are shops and food in the back corner of the temple. Just recognize that we will be mainly just watching the performances but people are free to peel off and shop around and grab food.

**Friday August 7**
(open 5 pm – 8 pm)

* 6:00 **MBT MINYO GROUP**
* 6:30 **CHICAGO AIKIKAI**
* 7:00 **MBT TAIKO GROUP**

Throughout Ginza MBT’s chapel will be open for viewing. During intermissions on Saturday and Sunday brief presentations will be given by one of our ministers. Click for more information about our [chapel tours](https://ginzaholiday.com/hondo-tour).

The festival also occurs on Saturday August 8, and Sunday August 9.

**About Ginza Festival:**
Ginza Holiday is MBT’s annual fundraising event that has been bringing Japanese American food, culture and entertainment to Chicago’s Old Town neighborhood for over 65 years. We’ve had an uninterrupted run of our annual Ginza event from it’s humble beginnings in 1955 up to 2019.

Visit their website for more information: [Here](https://ginzaholiday.com/)

Event:314462932.title: Argyle Night Market (Thursday) @ Argyle (Uptown)
Event:314462932.description:
**READ THE CHAT,*** we're* first *gonna meet-up* **@ HAIBAYÔ*** for \~15 min & then go to the event at **6:30pm\~6:40pm**.

This is a casual hangout event for those attending the *first*** Argyle Night Market **of the year. This outdoor street fest offers everything from sizzling Asian eats to lively performances! We'll wander the fest, chat, & grab food/drinks along the way. Whether you’re new to the group or a regular, this is a laid-back way to meet new people with similar interests!

**About Argyle Night Market**:
• An annual event on Thursday evenings each summer that features food from local Argyle restaurants plus live cultural & musical performances.
• Uptown United has partnered with several local arts organizations, able to bring live music, dance, & other performance styles to this market festival.
• Admission is 100% free!

**Schedule**:
•** 6:15pm**: So that folks can group-up & talk for a bit instead of struggling to find one another, there's a place nearby called HAIBAYÔ that has indoor seats.
•** 6:30pm \~ 6:40pm**: We'll clutter up as a group & enter the fest. I'll send updates about available spots to hangout at in the Meetup comments.
• **During Festival**: If you want to sync up with us mid-event, DM us in our...
• [WhatsApp](https://chat.whatsapp.com/Cfa83H3C76698eQpMx3Icb)
• or [Discord](https://discord.gg/QRg9duaHwK)
• or this Meetup chat!

*See you out there!*

Event:315052647.title: Anime Magic (Saturday) Meetup @ Hyatt Regency (Rosemont)
Event:315052647.description:
*Hey folks!* This is a hangout event for those attending **Anime Magic**'s *Saturday* convention!

• Launched in 2019, [Anime Magic](https://www.animemagic.org/) is a *mid*-sized *three*-day anime & JP culture convention held in **Rosemont, IL** (*just outside Chicago*).
• Similar to other notable anime cons like ACEN, there'll be a *vendor halls & artist alley*, *panels*, *guest VAs*, & *late-night events*.

As for *this meetup*, we plan to meet as a group at **\~1:00pm** inside the convention, talk & take pictures, probably get some lunch outside, then wander back in to explore more of the event hall! Whether you’re planning afterwards to *browse artist alley*, *attend panels*, or *just wanna wander around*, feel free to come hang out for a bit with new or familiar faces!

**Attending Anime Magic**:
• [Buy Badges~!](https://www.animemagic.org/badges)
• [See Convention Schedules~!](https://www.animemagic.org/schedules)

**Meetup Schedule**:
• **\~1 Hour Prior (12:00pm)**: Since different areas of the convention hall can get busy at different times based on event schedules, we'll try to figure out where we want to meet up in the con around this time. I'll send updates about available spots to hangout at in the Meetup comments.
• **1:00pm**: We'll start cluttering up as a group by this point at where we've decided to meet.
• **1:30pm**: At around this time, we'll probably leave the convention hall to go eat somewhere depending on the mood. Anyone's free to split off & explore or attend panels.
• **Afterwards**: If you want to sync up with us mid-event, post a message in our...
• or [Discord](https://discord.gg/QRg9duaHwK)
• or *this* Meetup chat!

*See you out there!*

Event:312553841.title: Acquaintances & Alcohol (Friday Social) @ Headquarters Beercade (River North)
Event:312553841.description:
***Hello old & new friends!*** We like to unwind on the *last Friday* of each month to do some chillmaxing (*whatever that means*) @ **Headquarters Beercade**!

This is a casual hangout event to talk with folks about *this* & *that*, while at a big cool bar that *lets you play arcade games for* ***free***. Even if you're *not* a super big anime nerd, feel free to connect w/ folks on *any* of your hobbies, interests, & experiences!

**About [Headquarters Beercade](https://www.hqrivernorth.com/)**:
• A funky arcade bar with loads of *throwback video games* & *films*, plus *creative craft beers*, *cocktails*, & *food*.
• **Bar Reminder**: You will need to bring & show your ID to staff in order to enter even if you *don't* plan on drinking.
• **From HQ Staff**: Please use the coat racks instead of leaving jackets lying around, & don't use the larger tables unless you intend to order drinks/food.

**Schedule**:
• **7:00pm**: Get your butt over to **Headquarters Beercade** (*don't forget your ID!*)
• **Post-Event**: Depending on how the group's feeling, we'll typically dip after *\~2\~3* hours & find a cool local place to eat at (like [Griddle 24](https://www.griddle24.com/)).
• **Also**: If you want to sync up with us pre/post-event, DM us in our...
• [WhatsApp](https://chat.whatsapp.com/Cfa83H3C76698eQpMx3Icb)
• or [Discord](https://discord.gg/QRg9duaHwK)
• or this Meetup chat!

*See you out there!*

Event:315286913.title: Summer Skate at Navy Pier
Event:315286913.description:
***Hello old & new friends!*** We like to unwind on the *last Friday* of each month. But this time we got something special. We will be going to Navy Pier for their Summer Skate event. Even if you're *not* a super big anime nerd, feel free to connect w/ folks on *any* of your hobbies, interests, & experiences or skate around like Shadow the Hedgehog!

Tickets are $20.38 per person and last from opening till closing so if you feel for skating beforehand, you're perfectly open to. You can buy tickets using clicking right [here](https://bucketlisters.com/experience/summer-skate-at-navy-pier).

About [Summer Skate at Navy Pier](https://navypier.org/pier-events/summerskate/):

* This event was opened as a summer alternative to Navy Pier's ice skating.
* It opens on June 18th and ends on September 7th.
* Skate rentals are included in the ticket price so you don't need to bring your own skates (unless you want to)
* There will be arcade games to play and even a DJ.

If you want to link up with people before, during, and/or after the event, feel free to join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/QRg9duaHwK).

*See you out there!*

This is a casual hangout event to talk with folks about *this* & *that*, while at a big cool bar that *lets you play arcade games for* ***free***. Even if you're *not* a super big anime nerd, feel free to connect w/ folks on *any* of your hobbies, interests, & experiences!

**About [Headquarters Beercade](https://www.hqrivernorth.com/)**:
• A funky arcade bar with loads of *throwback video games* & *films*, plus *creative craft beers*, *cocktails*, & *food*.
• **Bar Reminder**: You will need to bring & show your ID to staff in order to enter even if you *don't* plan on drinking.
• **From HQ Staff**: Please use the coat racks instead of leaving jackets lying around, & don't use the larger tables unless you intend to order drinks/food.

**Schedule**:
• **7:00pm**: Get your butt over to **Headquarters Beercade** (*don't forget your ID!*)
• **Post-Event**: Depending on how the group's feeling, we'll typically dip after *\~2\~3* hours & find a cool local place to eat at (like [Griddle 24](https://www.griddle24.com/)).
• **Also**: If you want to sync up with us pre/post-event, DM us in our...
• [WhatsApp](https://chat.whatsapp.com/Cfa83H3C76698eQpMx3Icb)
• or [Discord](https://discord.gg/QRg9duaHwK)
• or this Meetup chat!

*See you out there!*

series.description: Every 4th Friday of the month until November 26, 2026

Event:315356533.title: #WeTouchGrass Anime Rave @ Sound Bar (River North)
Event:315356533.description:
**Buy your tickets in advance**: [HERE](https://kydlabs.com/e/EV6ceb1178-9438-4ccb-8f6c-fadfff5a300c?referral_id=g-d5e4115a-9b26-4cf9-b9a0-f3602a6e62b6)
• *Tickets are also sold at the door, but typically cheaper if bought in-advance.*

Hey folks, **#WeTouchGrass** is back in town for another *exciting rave experience*! Join us for [drinks](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T28LyXf8MlU&pp=ygUZcGFzcyBtZSBhIGRyaW5rIGJhcnRlbmRlcg%3D%3D) & [dancing that lasts all night](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_8f2bhz5cFc&pp=ygUYcGVyc29uYSA0IGRhbmNpbmcgYWRhY2hp)!

**About [#WeTouchGrass](https://touchgrassent.live/)**
• Since *2022*, **Touch Grass Entertainment** has hosted worldwide rave events featuring *anime / J-Pop*, *video game*, & *K-Pop* music alike!
• Featuring *multiple performers* & *original remixes*!
• Cosplay allowed & welcomed! But keep in-mind that [props are ](https://touchgrassent.live/faq-rules/)***[not](https://touchgrassent.live/faq-rules/)***[ permitted](https://touchgrassent.live/faq-rules/).

**About [Sound Bar](https://sound-bar.com/)**
• A sizeable nightclub offering *multiple bars* & *a plethora of seating*.
• Check out [their calendar](https://sound-bar.com/event-calendar/) for more EDM events!

**Schedule**
• **7:00pm:** Some members will be at [Headquarters Beercade](https://www.meetup.com/chicago-anime-hangouts/events/312553843/?eventOrigin=group_events_list), our monthly social and may migrate over from pre-gaming/socializing there (8 minute walk away from Sound Bar).
• **9:00pm**: Doors open. We *might* try to coordinate a specific spot to chill at until the performances start.

*Hope to see you there!*

Event:315203884.title: Bronzeville Summer Nights 2026 (Bronzeville)
Event:315203884.description:
**READ THE CHAT,*** we're* first *gonna meet-up* **@ 47th Street (Green Line)*** for \~15 min & then go to the event at **1:00pm\~1:15pm**.

This is a casual hangout event for those attending the** Bronzeville Summer Nights 2026**. This outdoor event offers everything specific to Bronzeville! We'll wander the area, chat, & grab food/drinks along the way. Whether you’re new to the group or a regular, this is a laid-back way to meet new people with similar interests!

**About Bronzeville Summer Nights 2026**:
• The Quad Communities Development Corporation (QCDC) is proud to announce the return of its signature event series, Bronzeville Summer Nights
Join QCDC as we celebrate the "Three Cs": Commerce, Community, and Culture. This is our invitation to follow the music through our corridors, directly into the shops and restaurants that make Bronzeville home. From our summer kicks-offs to our new family-friendly "Fall" finale, come experience the soul of the Bronzeville.
Admission: Free and open to the public.
More Information: Visit ShopLocalBronzeville.com

**Schedule**:
•** 12:45 pm**: So that folks can group-up & talk for a bit instead of struggling to find one another, let's meet at the 47th Street station.
•** 1:00 pm \~ 1:10pm**: We'll clutter up as a group & enter the fest. I'll send updates about available spots to hangout at in the Meetup comments.
• **During Festival**: If you want to sync up with us mid-event, DM us in our...
[Discord](https://discord.gg/QRg9duaHwK)
• or this Meetup chat!

*See you out there!*

Event:314490706.title: Bring Your Own Manga Book Club @ Goblin Market (Manga Shop) (Lakeview)
Event:314490706.description:
hi - bring what you've been reading whether it's manga, light novels, manhwa, and more. hope to talk about what we've been reading, exchange recommendations, and more. just show up :D

this will be a reoccurring monthly event at Goblin Market, a manga shop located in Chicago's Lakeview neighborhood. once you enter, head down to their basement with seating. outside food is allowed but please be respectful of the venue.

\-\-\-
From Goblin Market: for curious minds seeking a curated selection of manga, comics, games and more—Goblin Market is Chicago’s destination for first-timers and enthusiasts alike. Step inside, explore our collection and always ask us questions.
We’re delighted you are here.

\~\~\~
we hope to see you there!

Event:315692209.title: Board Games (Dice Dojo) (Edgewater)
Event:315692209.description:
board game meetup for chicago anime hangouts! hope to play some board games and have conversations about anime, and manga and more. just show up :D

dice dojo has 1000+ games in their demo library. please support them if there’s a game you like and want to purchase.

**feel free to bring what you'd like to play!**

schedule:
6:00 pm: show up / checkin and get started with board games. their board game night starts at 5:00 and ends at 10:00 pm.

name tags will be brought to indicate who's apart of the meetup.

\-\-\-

hope to see you there!
\-\-\-

Thank you to the '[Chicagoland 20’s and 30’s Young Professionals](https://www.meetup.com/oak-park-west-suburbs-young-professionals/)' Meetup for advice on hosting board games. :D

Event:314738674.title: Nourishing Hope - Online Market Evening Packing (Volunteer) (West Town)
Event:314738674.description:
meetup for chicago anime hangouts! hope to have conversations about anime, and manga and more. just show up :D just note that this is the first event focused around volunteering, and helping people, so be prepared to learn more about the non-profit we're working with in addition to the socializing aspect, and getting a meal or dessert afterwards.

Nourishing Hope is an established Chicago food pantry, providing free food in a comfortable person-focused environment, with social and mental health services.

**INSTRUCTIONS FOR SIGNING UP TO VOLUNTEER AT BOTTOM**

**description:** come help us pack orders for Nourishing Hope's Online Market! Then we will load orders into the van for distribution. Volunteers are encouraged to wear comfortable clothing and closed toed shoes. Gloves provided at individual shifts.

**schedule:**
**5:30:** get trained to help load orders and pack for Nourishing Hope.
**post-meetup:** open to walk to Sabroso! Mexican Grill (624 N Ashland Ave, Chicago, IL 60622 - 8 minute walk away) to grab a light meal, or grab smoothies/dessert nearby.

we hope to see you there!

**\-\-\-INSTRUCTIONS\-\-\-**
**Volunteering at Nourishing Hope (formerly Lakeview Pantry):**
Register to be a volunteer: **[Form link](https://lakeviewpantry.my.site.com/volunteer/s/group-registration?group_code=3723).**

**Already have a volunteer account?** Login into your personal volunteer site ([link here](https://lakeviewpantry.my.site.com/volunteer/s/group-registration?group_code=3723)), click Volunteer Calendar, and enter the group code: **3723** under "**I have a Group Code.**"[ Watch this helpful video!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tou-bRF0i8Y&feature=youtu.be)
